digest.component_or_area: rebar-debug skill and defect tracking workflow
propositions: rebar-debug currently fails to record the originating ticket (caused_by relation) that introduced a defect before closing the bug, losing defect escape metrics

The fallback blame auto-derivation incorrectly attributes defects to whoever wrote most of the file rather than who introduced the defect, and cannot detect unmet-obligation cases where a fix lands in consumer code but the obligation originated in a producer

Skill documentation must add a required attribution step in Phase 1 Stage 3 that traces the exact implicated lines through commits, detects fix-site-vs-cause-site divergence via date comparison, and records the origin with --caused-by on close

The --caused-by flag must be supplied on bug close even when the caused_by link was already recorded via rebar link, because _apply_caused_by unconditionally derives a second guessed edge when the flag is absent

Both rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills must bootstrap worktrees with make worktree instead of bare git worktree add, and run commands with the worktree venv on PATH to avoid pre-commit hook failures
